name: Lakeville Wednesday Match Play
oneLiner: Two-person team match play, team against team over 18 holes, handicapped so a first-timer and a scratch player can have a genuinely tight night. League Member Extra’s: (2) Hours of anytime sim time to use outside of league!
beginnerNote: Match play is scored hole by hole rather than over the whole round, so one bad hole costs you that hole and nothing more. Handicaps set the strokes, and a rough start is forgotten by the next tee.
format: 2-person team-vs-team match play, handicapped, 18 holes. Format may change based on player feedback.
price: $980 per team. A $50 non-refundable deposit per team holds your spot.
prizes: Prizes dependent on size of League
